literal_meaning: exhausted or weakened (from Arabic origin, meaning fatigued)
example_sentences_in_bangla: রোগে ভুগতে ভুগতে কাহিল হয়ে পড়েছি।
দীর্ঘ যাত্রায় সবাই কাহিল হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I became exhausted from suffering from the illness.
Everyone got tired from the long journey.
note: Derived from Arabic 'kāhil', commonly used in Bengali to describe physical or mental fatigue.
